externalReview.choice: Article 13: a 15-EC accessible EUR minor or an approved coherent external package. Requests to use study outside the EUR minor offer must be submitted eight weeks before it begins.
externalReview.progression: Article 43 and Appendix 5: completion of B1 plus 42 EC from B2 for entry to B3. The minor is accessible from the third enrolment year. Conditional access to JAV III and Recht en Bedrijf at 28 EC from B2 requires reaching 42 EC at the specified results checkpoints. The reconstructed ordinary pathway completes all earlier-year components.
externalReview.thesis: Article 18, printed pages 10–11: research preparation in period 2 and the thesis in periods 3–4. All parts are required. The thesis accounts for 70% of the component grade and requires at least 6.
externalReview.BSA: Article 29: 60 EC from B1 for ordinary full-time students, subject to the stated compensation and personal-circumstances provisions.
externalReview.discoveryStoppingReason: The current formal source and current curriculum adequately establish identity, allEC, constrainedchoice, ordinarysequence and definingcontent. IndividualOsirispages are not required for further credit corroboration.

academicReview.programmeComparability: Three qualified comparisons are approved. Options 1 and 3 each contain eight law/rights courses (60 EC), while option 2 contains five (37.5 EC) and concentrates on public authority, international institutions, historical power and civil society. These figures describe their actual content; they are not a numerical approval threshold. The substantive legal courses study sources, cases, rights, legal reasoning and named public/private fields. Specific complementary study supports the broad Law target’s questions. Missing Dutch doctrinal depth, dedicated procedure, compulsory legal skills and a legal thesis are explicit limitations. A coherent politics or business programme and a disclaimer alone would not justify approval.
